title: Storage Connector Interface

permissions.description: Every storage operation is denied unless its declared permission is explicitly granted.
permissions.claim_boundary: Permissions are enforced against a local granted-set only; no live provider consent flow is exercised. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

list_roots.description: Roots are addressed by opaque storageref handles; malformed handles are dropped rather than trusted.
list_roots.claim_boundary: No provider root discovery is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

list_entries.description: Entry paths are canonicalized and traversal, absolute, drive-letter, and backslash escapes fail closed.
list_entries.claim_boundary: No live directory enumeration or pagination is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

metadata.description: Entry metadata is provider-neutral and UTC-normalized with an opaque revision token.
metadata.claim_boundary: No provider-specific metadata field is claimed or stored. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

upload.description: Uploads are planned only for paths absent remotely and gated by the write-upload permission.
upload.claim_boundary: No bytes are transferred; only the local plan shape is defined. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

download.description: Downloads are planned only for paths absent locally and gated by the read-download permission.
download.claim_boundary: No bytes are transferred; only the local plan shape is defined. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

delta.description: Delta planning is deterministic and surfaces revision conflicts instead of silently overwriting.
delta.claim_boundary: No causal ordering or clock-based reconciliation is claimed; conflicts must be resolved by the caller. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

delete.description: Deletion is destructive and denied unless explicitly confirmed; invalid paths are denied first.
delete.claim_boundary: No remote deletion is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Health reports unavailable, degraded, or ok deterministically from reachability, authorization, and quota.
health.claim_boundary: Health is computed from caller-supplied local signals, not a live provider probe. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local storage connector interface contract, not a live storage client.
No plaintext root handle, credential, or provider root identifier is stored or returned.
Live enumeration, transfer, deletion, quota enforcement, and provider health probes remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
